transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm here because... well, I keep hearing a voice. It's Garrett's voice. I hear it as clearly as if he's standing right behind me, like when I'm out on a trail or when I'm in my painting room. And the thing is, part of me knows he's dead. But when it happens, in that exact moment, it feels completely real to me.
Besides hearing Garrett's voice, have you experienced any other unusual sensations or perceptions, like seeing things, feeling touches, or smelling things that others don't?
No, it's just the voice. I haven't seen anything that isn't there, or felt anything strange. No weird smells either. It's really just Garrett's voice that I hear.
Do you have any thoughts or beliefs about why Garrett’s voice is speaking to you or what it means when you hear it?

Not really, no. I mean, I don't think there's some... grand meaning behind it, or that he's trying to send me a message from beyond or anything like that. It just happens. I'll be painting, or out walking, and he's just there talking to me. I wish I knew why it was happening, but I honestly don't have an explanation for it. It's just something I'm experiencing.
Have there been times when you believed something was true, even though others told you it wasn’t, and it turned out they were right?

No, not really. I mean... I haven't had anything like that. Aside from the voice feeling so real in the moment, I haven't held onto any beliefs that other people had to correct me on. I know what's real, it's just... this one specific thing happening with Garrett's voice. But no, no other strange beliefs or anything like that.
Have you ever experienced any other strange or unusual thoughts, or sensed things that others around you didn't seem to notice, outside of hearing Garrett’s voice?

No, I really haven't. Like I said before, it's... it's just the voice. I haven't noticed anything else out of the ordinary, no weird thoughts or... or seeing things or anything like that. Just Garrett.
Have you ever experienced any other hallucinations or unusual thoughts when you were not feeling particularly sad, anxious, or emotionally upset?

No, it really only started during that time when I was... well, when I was just wired. You know, that stretch where I barely slept at all and I was taking on all those impossible projects, just feeling totally driven to keep going. I had never heard him like that before my mood shifted that way. It wasn't something that happened during just... ordinary grief, or when I was feeling down. It was only during that really revved-up time.
Have you ever experienced any delusions or other strange beliefs when you were not in a particularly high or revved-up mood?

No, I haven't. Like I mentioned a minute ago, I really haven't had any strange beliefs at all—it's just been hearing Garrett's voice. And even that... no, nothing unusual happens when my mood is normal. I don't have any strange thoughts or hear anything when I'm just feeling regular. It was strictly tied to that time when I was completely wired.
Have you experienced any episodes where your mood was significantly elevated, depressed, or mixed around the time you heard Garrett's voice?

Like I was saying, it was really just during that one specific time. I only started hearing Garrett's voice when I was in that really wired stretch—when I was barely sleeping at all, taking on all those impossible projects, and just feeling completely driven to keep going. I had never heard him like that before my mood shifted that way. It wasn't something that happened during, you know, just ordinary grief or when I was feeling down. It was only when I was completely revved up and elevated like that.
After that wired time when you were hearing Garrett’s voice, did you experience a period where you felt extremely down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for several days or more?

Yeah, I did. After that whole revved-up stretch ended, I really crashed. It was... well, the things that usually anchor me just felt completely flat and unreachable. 

I usually paint, play guitar, go to rehearsals at the theater, and, you know, even just sitting with my patients at work... none of it held any interest for me anymore. I couldn't connect with any of it. It just felt like I was going through the motions of a life that had completely stopped meaning anything.

Before you heard Garrett’s voice during that wired time, did you have a distinct period where your mood was extremely elevated, you felt unusually energetic, or you needed less sleep but still had lots of energy?

Yeah, that's how it started. Before I ever heard his voice, there was this stretch where... well, at first I felt almost lit up. It was like I had this urgent purpose that no one else could see, and I was completely driven by it. But I was also really on edge. If anyone questioned what I was doing or, you know, tried to slow me down, I would just snap into a complete rage.

After you heard Garrett's voice and during the time you felt extremely down and disconnected, did you have little to no interest in doing things most of the day, nearly every day, or feel hopeless or worthless for at least two weeks?

Yeah, it definitely went on for at least two weeks. I just... I felt completely useless. I keep replaying every last conversation I had with Garrett in my head. And then with my practice, I think about every cancelled patient session... I just convinced myself that I completely failed everyone. It really got to the point where I felt like people would just be better off if I weren't in the way.

During that wired time when you first heard Garrett's voice, did you also experience other changes like feeling overly confident, talking more than usual, having racing thoughts, or being easily distracted?

Yeah, I did. I was talking a lot more than usual. People kept telling me to slow down because I was just talking over them. I'd be jumping from ideas for my clinical practice, to things about Garrett, to plans for the theater... it was all coming out so fast. I just felt this intense pressure in my chest to keep going, like I had to get all the words out before they just disappeared.
Have you ever experienced a time when you heard Garrett’s voice or had other unusual thoughts when your mood was completely stable and you weren’t feeling extremely high or low?

No, it hasn't happened like that. I only started hearing Garrett's voice during that wired stretch I told you about... you know, when I was barely sleeping and taking on all those impossible projects and just felt completely driven to keep going. I had never heard him like that before the mood shifted. It wasn't something that just happened during... well, ordinary grief. It was only when I was in that really elevated state.
During that wired time when you heard Garrett's voice, did you also hear any other voices or sounds that others around you didn't seem to notice?

No, it was just Garrett. That's actually why I came in, to be honest. I just keep hearing his voice. It's as clear as if he's standing right behind me, like when I'm out on the trail or in my painting room. It's... well, part of me knows he's dead, obviously, but when it happens, in that exact moment, it feels completely real. But no, I haven't heard any other voices or sounds besides him.
